commands.cmd: cd blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery || exit 2; python3 serve.py > .runtime/serve-receipt.log 2>&1 & pid=$!; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fs -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:18080 && break; sleep 0.5; done; s=receipt$(date +%s); t="Receipt probe $(date +%s)"; cd "${TMPDIR:?}" || exit 2; playwright-cli -s=$s open http://127.0.0.1:18080 --browser=chrome > /dev/null && snap=$(playwright-cli -s=$s snapshot) && box=$(printf '%s\n' "$snap" | grep 'textbox "Run title"' | grep -o 'ref=e[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2) && btn=$(printf '%s\n' "$snap" | grep 'button "Create run"' | grep -o 'ref=e[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2) && playwright-cli -s=$s fill $box "$t" > /dev/null && playwright-cli -s=$s click $btn > /dev/null && sleep 1 && playwright-cli -s=$s snapshot | grep -A1 "heading \"$t\"" | tail -1 && playwright-cli -s=$s console | grep 'Total messages' && playwright-cli -s=$s close > /dev/null; rc=$?; kill $pid; wait $pid 2>/dev/null; if curl -fs -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:18080; then echo 'server still up'; exit 1; fi; echo 'servers stopped'; exit $rc
